newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Juppe creeps up in opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: France's Juppe creeps up in opinion poll.

text.p: The proportion of French voters dissatisfied with Prime Minister Alain Juppe's performance dropped this month from 67 to 63 percent, according to an opinion poll released on Saturday.

The IFOP survey of 1,800 voters to be published on Sunday in the weekly Journal du Dimanche said 25 percent were satisfied with the conservative Juppe, up from 24 percent in December and 20 percent in November.
President Jacques Chirac's standing was unchanged with 30 percent expressing satisfaction.
Chirac and Juppe face discontent over record unemployment and austerity measures intended to help France to qualify for a single European currency.
